text:
A coat of ink and ivory, stark and bright,
The zebra stands, a living work of art.
Within the garden’s hush, the shadows light,
As nature speaks to those who pause to start.

The flowers bloom with promises untold,
Their petals unfurl in silent grace,
Revealing splendor, ancient and bold,
A hidden beauty in each delicate face.

The trees stand guard, sentinels of green,
Their leaves whisper wisdom through the breeze,
A quiet strength, a serene, unseen scene,
Where time and earth and spirit interweave.

Here solace finds the weary heart and mind,
In simple growth, in cycles deep and true,
Each bloom and leaf, a story to be signed,
Of time’s passage, in all its old and new.
